about: Extra sections on block cards, read by the apps and by bkcb6.app's block cards. conamed: by block slug, the honorary name, the law, who it honors, the organization behind it and its ceremony while the day is ahead (pin: [lat, lng] puts the flyer on the block map). streetEvents: by street name, events whose flyer is a button on every block of that street until their last day; a street may point at another street's list with =<street>. An event's date and label find its entry on the CB6 calendar; img is a flyer in civic/cal/flyers.

coffey-street--the-end-of-the-street--fe.name: Fort Defiance Place
coffey-street--the-end-of-the-street--fe.limits: Coffey Street between Ferris Street and the piers
coffey-street--the-end-of-the-street--fe.passed: approved by the City Council June 30, 2026, in effect July 30, 2026
coffey-street--the-end-of-the-street--fe.honors: Fort Defiance, the Revolutionary-era redoubt built on Red Hook in 1776 to guard Upper New York Bay: during the Battle of Brooklyn on August 27, 1776, its guns traded fire with HMS Roebuck in Buttermilk Channel until the damaged frigate withdrew to anchorage.
